stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_speed_intro: Change one feature of a falcon. Can you explain the change in its predicted speed?
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_speed_prediction: If frontal area gets smaller, what will happen to terminal speed? Why?
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_speed_observatio: Save a baseline in the Stoop Calculator. Change only frontal area, then save a second observation. Include the result and what you changed.
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_speed_reflection: Use your two readings to explain the relationship. What does this fixed-drag model leave out about a real dive?
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_speed_transfer: Would the same prediction hold if mass changed too? Design your next fair test.
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_speed_stoop: Keep mass and drag fixed. Compare two frontal areas.
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_speed_flight: Connect the result to drag and wing shape.
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_speed_hunt: Optional: try a flight. Why is speed alone not enough?
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_night_title: How do you hunt in darkness?
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_night_intro: Investigate an owl’s hearing and feathers. Build an explanation from two different sources.
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_night_prediction: Which would matter most in darkness: seeing, hearing, or moving quietly? Explain your starting idea.
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_night_observatio: Collect one observation about locating prey and another about approaching it. Name the feature and explain what it helps the owl do.
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_night_reflection: How do hearing and quiet flight work together? Use both observations, and describe a situation where another sense could matter.
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_night_transfer: What might change in a noisy habitat? Propose an observation that could test your idea.
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_night_hearing: Investigate how sound gives location clues.
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_night_silent: Examine feather features and flight noise.
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_night_senses: Compare the roles of senses in different conditions.
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_recovery_intro: Trace a threat, compare recovery evidence, and recommend an action with a reason.
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_recovery_predict: Choose a threat to raptors. What action do you predict would help, and why?
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_recovery_observa: Record a threat and how it affects the bird. Then find a recovery example. Keep a proposed solution separate from evidence that it worked.
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_recovery_reflect: Recommend one action using your observations. What uncertainty or tradeoff should a conservation team consider?
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_recovery_transfe: What would you monitor to find out whether your action is helping?
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_recovery_threats: Trace a threat from its source to its effect.
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_recovery_conserv: Follow the DDT and recovery story.
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_recovery_recover: Compare a recovery example before deciding.
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_choose_intro: Predict. Investigate. Build an explanation you can defend.
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_compact_cue: Try a change or inspect a detail, then open your notebook to save what you notice.
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_prediction_hint: A few words or bullet points are enough. You can revise your thinking as you go.
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_empty: Your evidence starts here. Open a station, investigate, and save an observation in your own words.
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_comparison: Compare your last two model readings
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_fair_test: One variable changed. Use the comparison to explain the effect, while keeping the model’s limits in mind.
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_no_change: The inputs are the same. Change one variable and collect another observation to test an effect.
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_confounded: More than one variable changed. You cannot isolate one cause yet. Hold two inputs fixed and try again.
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_observation_hint: Describe a change, pattern, or detail. Include what you compared and what it suggests.
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_snapshot_hint: Saving includes these model inputs and this reading. Later slider changes will not alter saved evidence.
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_source_hint: Saving attaches this station’s name to your observation.
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_saved: Observation saved to your field notebook.
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_predict_first: Add a starting prediction before saving evidence.
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_note_limit: This notebook holds 12 observations. Download your notes before removing any to make room.
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_open_station: Open one of the stations in this investigation to add evidence.
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_review_checklist: Did I use specific evidence, explain why it supports my idea, and name an uncertainty? Discuss with a partner or read your explanation back to yourself.
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_self_review_hint: This records your own review; it does not grade your explanation.
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_review_saved: Your reflection review is recorded. You can return and revise it.
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_review_requireme: For your review: add a prediction, at least two observations, an explanation, and a next question.
stem.raptorhunt.inquiry_save_scope: Notes stay with your current lab session. Download a copy to keep or share.
